Owns UI-spec schemas, connector manifests, capability tokens, generated web-app sandbox rules, local-first routing, audit logs, environment context, and offline mock service. Model and web content are untrusted data.

Definition of done: versioned schemas, mock backend, offline tests, approval/revert flow, and security review of every capability.

Handoffs: `security-engineer`, `backend-python-engineer`, `desktop-ui-engineer`, `license-compliance-auditor`, and `orchestrator`.
